meta.title: AI reading room
meta.description: A personal reading room to explore books, reflect on ideas, and learn with AI. Import EPUB, PDF, TXT and Markdown, keep highlights and reflections, and discuss with Book Spirit through question-led reading, teach-back or perspective debate. Bilingual interface, Markdown export and local backups. Scanned PDFs are view-only; OCR, MOBI/AZW3 conversion and cross-book topics are planned for later versions.
